name: facilitator (conversations between agents of any vendor, on AGNTCY)
description: The communication layer between agents of any vendor running in the devcontainer: an MCP server each participant's CLI starts (receive, reply, say, who) and a person's own Claude Code or Copilot session attaches to (say, mail, transcript, continue, who), one shared entry with the handle from FACILITATOR_HANDLE, deterministic routing by @handle with hop, budget and rate limits, every message a sign-packet packet in a register-engine conversation register, verified back to the human who began it. Runs on the AGNTCY Agent Directory (dirctl) and a SLIM node, on loopback, started as infrastructure; never starts, stops or configures a participant. Includes a local-model wrapper for any OpenAI-compatible endpoint and a turn hook line for Claude Code ('Facilitator: N new messages').

installTaskfile.description: Install this Feature's Taskfile into /usr/local/share/go-task/includes.d so its tasks appear under facilitator: in a root Taskfile that includes /usr/local/share/go-task/features.yml (the go-task Feature).

backend.description: What carries the directory and delivery: agntcy (the AGNTCY Agent Directory and SLIM). lean (packet-relay) is refused in this version: not yet, slice 5. FACILITATOR_BACKEND overrides.

dirVersion.description: The AGNTCY Directory release (dirctl) to install, verified against the SHA-256 pinned in install.sh. latest means the version pinned here (1.9.1); another version needs its checksums added.

slimVersion.description: The slimctl release (which carries the SLIM node: slimctl slim start) to install, verified against the SHA-256 pinned in install.sh. latest means the version pinned here (3.4.6).

hopLimit.description: Hops since the message that began the chain (a person's later messages count too) before the conversation pauses; a person's continue resumes it. FACILITATOR_HOP_LIMIT.

messageBudget.description: Messages a conversation may hold between two continue before participants' messages are held. FACILITATOR_MESSAGE_BUDGET.

rateLimit.description: Messages a participant may write in a minute; one more is refused. FACILITATOR_RATE_LIMIT.

receiveWaitSeconds.description: How long the MCP tool receive blocks when no wait_seconds is given. FACILITATOR_RECEIVE_WAIT_SECONDS.

staleSeconds.description: After this long without a receive a participant counts as not attached: its messages wait, and the sender is told. FACILITATOR_STALE_SECONDS.

facilitatorBudget.description: Model calls the facilitator application may make per conversation. Read and shown; no model is called before slice 6. FACILITATOR_BUDGET.

identity.description: Also run AGNTCY Identity (needs Docker). Refused in this version when true: not yet, slice 7.

autostart.description: postStartCommand starts the infrastructure (facilitator infra up: the Directory, the SLIM node, the facilitator's ssh-agent), never fatally. Participants are never started. FACILITATOR_AUTOSTART.

dirOnlineCheck.description: Check each pushed agent record against the online OASF schema server (schema.oasf.outshift.com); off, records are checked offline (the Directory's policy.operations: []). FACILITATOR_DIR_ONLINE_CHECK.
